C2  one repair step with the cap removed; finite-difference check of the KL change
   cap on  (trust_radius=0.05)          ||delta|| 0.05   KL 3.37302 -> 3.23838  (dKL -0.1346)   grad(KL).delta = -0.1368   same sign
                                        cos(delta, grad KL) = -0.9949  (+1 would be pure KL ascent, -1 pure descent)
   cap off (trust_radius=1e9)           ||delta|| 0.3239   KL 3.37302 -> 2.59346  (dKL -0.7796)   grad(KL).delta = -0.8862   same sign
                                        cos(delta, grad KL) = -0.9949  (+1 would be pure KL ascent, -1 pure descent)
   cap off, lr=1e-4 (linear regime)     ||delta|| 0.003239   KL 3.37302 -> 3.36416  (dKL -0.008853)   grad(KL).delta = -0.008862   same sign
                                        cos(delta, grad KL) = -0.9949  (+1 would be pure KL ascent, -1 pure descent)
   VERDICT: one repair step RAISES KL with or without the cap, and the first-order prediction grad(KL).delta has the same sign, so the step is pointed up the KL gradient; the cap is not the cause, it only bounds the rate.
